data.summary: Landed on main as e5abb63 (PR 56, squash), per the answered escalation: command name tuhdoo protocol, init pointer-only. docs/agent-protocol.md ships in the binary via a tiny root package (embed.go, package tuhdoo) since go:embed cannot climb out of a package dir; tuhdoo protocol prints it byte-for-byte to stdout — pure print, no repo, no daemon, extra args rejected. Tests pin both guarantees: TestProtocolEmbedMatchesDoc (embed cannot drift from the file) and TestProtocolCommandPrintsDocAnywhere (real binary in a non-repo temp dir: byte-equal output, exit 0, no files created, descriptions-are-prompts heading and its five parts present, help lists it). init success output gained the pointer line (asserted in TestInitRemoteless); README and docs/adopting.md each gained a sentence; the convention is never restated anywhere. No MCP changes. make test lint green. Binary changed — deploy restart happening right after this finish.
